scenes.title: Prototype-like Storage pane (light UI, sidebar, list, buttons, card, gradient banner)

texts.text: Your Mac is using 186.2 GB of 494.4 GB. Optimize storage to free up space automatically by removing items you no longer need, such as watched movies, old email attachments and duplicate downloads.
texts.translation: 你的 Mac 已使用 494.4 GB 中的 186.2 GB。优化储存空间可自动移除不再需要的项目（例如已看过的影片、旧的邮件附件和重复的下载项），从而释放空间。

texts.text: Store in iCloud — Keep files and photos in iCloud and free up space when needed.
texts.translation: 储存在 iCloud 中 — 将文件和照片保留在 iCloud 中，并在需要时释放空间。

texts.text: Optimize Storage — Remove movies and TV shows you’ve already watched from this Mac.
texts.translation: 优化储存空间 — 从这台 Mac 上移除已看过的电影和电视节目。

texts.text: Empty Trash Automatically — Erase items that have been in the Trash for more than 30 days.
texts.translation: 自动清倒废纸篓 — 抹掉在废纸篓中存放超过 30 天的项目。

texts.text: Get 2 TB of iCloud+ free for 3 months
texts.translation: 免费畅享 3 个月 2 TB iCloud+
优惠截至 10 月 31 日，可随时取消。

scenes.title: Dark UI settings panel with secondary gray text and toggles

texts.text: Adjusts colors to match the light around you
texts.translation: 根据周围环境光自动调整颜色
日落后使用更暖的色调

scenes.title: Colored buttons, pills, segmented control, tag and link
Gradient banner (plate backdrop expected) with a solid white pill

texts.translation: 让每一张截图都物尽其用

texts.text: Annotate, translate and share in seconds — right where you capture.
texts.translation: 截图后即可标注、翻译与分享，几秒钟就能完成。

scenes.title: Photo-like noisy background with white captions (plate expected)

texts.translation: 使用 iPhone 拍摄 · 26 毫米 · f/1.8

texts.text: Waves roll in as the sun sets behind the cliffs, painting the sky in warm orange and pink.
texts.translation: 夕阳落到悬崖背后，海浪翻涌而来，把天空染成温暖的橙色和粉色。

texts.text: Cubby keeps a searchable history of everything you copy, including text, images, links and files. Items stay on this Mac and are never uploaded. You can pin frequently used snippets, organize them into collections, and paste any item with a single keystroke.
texts.translation: Cubby 会保存你拷贝过的所有内容的可搜索历史记录，包括文本、图片、链接和文件。所有项目都只保存在这台 Mac 上，绝不会上传。你可以固定常用片段、将它们整理到收藏夹中，并通过一次按键粘贴任意项目。

texts.text: Older items are removed automatically after thirty days unless they are pinned. To change how long items are kept, open Settings and choose History.
texts.translation: 除非已固定，较早的项目会在三十天后自动移除。若要更改项目的保留时长，请打开“设置”并选择“历史记录”。
最后更新于 2026 年 9 月 27 日

scenes.title: Bulleted and numbered lists (markers must stay)

texts.text: Copy anything: text, images, files and links.
texts.translation: 拷贝任何内容：文本、图片、文件和链接。

texts.text: Search your history instantly with fuzzy matching, even across thousands of items stored over several months.
texts.translation: 使用模糊匹配即时搜索历史记录，即使是数月来储存的数千个项目也能快速找到。

texts.text: Pin snippets you use every day.
texts.translation: 固定每天都会用到的片段。

texts.text: Open Cubby from the menu bar.
Choose Settings, then click Shortcuts to pick a hotkey.
texts.translation: 选取“设置”，然后点按“快捷键”以选择一个热键。

texts.text: Press the hotkey anywhere to show your clipboard history.
texts.translation: 在任意位置按下该热键即可显示剪贴板历史记录。

texts.text: Screenshots are saved to the history automatically. Select any region of the screen, annotate it with arrows, text and highlights, then copy it or drag it straight into another app.
texts.translation: 截图会自动保存到历史记录中。选择屏幕上的任意区域，用箭头、文字和高亮进行标注，然后拷贝或直接拖到其他应用中。

texts.text: Everything stays on your Mac. Cubby never uploads your clipboard, and it skips passwords and other sensitive items copied from password managers.
texts.translation: 所有内容都保留在你的 Mac 上。Cubby 从不上传你的剪贴板，并会跳过从密码管理器中拷贝的密码和其他敏感项目。

texts.translation: 一个住在菜单栏里、井井有条的剪贴板历史与截图工具。

texts.translation: Manage software updates, storage and the items that open automatically when you log in. Some settings require an administrator password.
